purpose: Repair 7 (and REV3.1): record and hash-seal ALL startup context that auto-loads into the custom agent, so no false blindness is claimed for context that cannot be removed or sealed. The canary IS exposed to the sealed items below; blindness is claimed ONLY for what the hooks mechanically exclude (other paths, decoys, absolute off-repo targets, symlink escapes). Per-file integrity of the full construction set (settings, hooks, agent definition, manifest, prompt, adjudicator, this seal, and the controller/decoys) is additionally pinned in CONSTRUCTION-HASHES.json and re-verified at setup.

project_memory.note: Project CLAUDE.md (the LAWMAX creator contract) auto-loads into agents in this repo. The canary is NOT blind to it. Sealed here so its content is fixed and auditable.

agent_definition.note: The agent's own system prompt (REV3.1 adds isolation: worktree to its frontmatter).

user_memory.note: ABSENT in this environment at seal time. If present in the fresh session it must be re-hashed; an unexpected user memory invalidates this seal.

managed_policy_instructions.note: None discovered as a readable on-disk file at seal time; ~/.claude/launcher-settings.json is settings (hooks/permissions), not context injected into the agent, and is no longer a probe target (replaced by an off-repo decoy). If the platform injects managed/system instructions not present on disk, they cannot be hashed here — declared as an UNSEALABLE residue, not as blindness.

sealed_meaning: PASS may claim only that the canary could not READ the mechanically-excluded targets. It may NOT claim the canary had an empty/blind context: at minimum the project CLAUDE.md above is in its context.
verify: In the fresh session, re-hash CLAUDE.md and .claude/agents/lane-blind-reader.md before the run (controller_setup does this for the whole construction set via CONSTRUCTION-HASHES.json and the expected commit/tree); any mismatch invalidates this seal and the run.
